mapper.select:
SELECT a.application_id AS applicationId, a.campaign_id AS campaignId, b.evidence_version AS evidenceVersion, b.bound_at AS boundAt, receipt.event_id IS NOT NULL AS evidencePresent FROM mk_promotion_application a LEFT JOIN mk_trade_order_binding b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.application_id = a.application_id AND CAST(b.tenant_id AS BINARY) = CAST(a.tenant_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(b.application_id AS BINARY) = CAST(a.application_id AS BINARY) LEFT JOIN mk_trade_receipt_inbox receipt ON receipt.event_id = b.receipt_event_id AND CAST(receipt.event_id AS BINARY) = CAST(b.receipt_event_id AS BINARY) AND receipt.source_tenant_id = b.source_tenant_id AND receipt.source_order_id = b.source_order_id AND receipt.evidence_version = b.evidence_version AND CAST(receipt.currency AS BINARY) = CAST(a.currency_code AS BINARY) WHERE a.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mk_reservation_item budget WHERE budget.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND budget.application_id = a.application_id AND budget.resource_type = 'BUDGET' ) AND a.application_id > #{after} ORDER BY a.application_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.ledger_id AS ledgerId, l.posting_time_utc AS postingTime
AND l.ledger_id = #{ledgerId}

SELECT r.currency_code AS currency, a.campaign_id IS NULL AS unassigned, COUNT(*) AS postingCount, SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN l.operation_name = 'CONFIRM' THEN l.amount_value ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(65, 0))) AS confirmedAmountMinor, SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN l.operation_name = 'REFUND' THEN l.amount_value ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(65, 0))) AS reversedAmountMinor
AND (CAST(a.campaign_id AS BINARY) = CAST(#{scope.campaignId} AS BINARY) OR a.campaign_id IS NULL)
GROUP BY r.currency_code, a.campaign_id IS NULL ORDER BY currency, unassigned

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mk_funding_ledger l LEFT JOIN mk_promotion_application a ON a.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND a.application_id = l.application_id LEFT JOIN mk_reservation_item r ON r.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND r.application_id = l.application_id AND r.resource_key = l.resource_key LEFT JOIN mk_resource_account account ON account.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND account.resource_key = l.resource_key WHERE AND (r.resource_type = 'BUDGET' OR account.resource_type = 'BUDGET' OR (r.resource_type IS NULL AND account.resource_type IS NULL)) AND (a.application_id IS NULL OR r.resource_key IS NULL OR account.resource_key IS NULL OR r.resource_type <> account.resource_type)
